rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God conceals the unseen and people's ends: He may lead people from error or hostility into sainthood, so no one knows the destiny prepared for them.
rows.anchor: فالعواقب مستورة ، والخواتيم مبهمة ، والخلق في غفلة عما يراد بهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: People were created without consultation or choice, and at birth they did not know whether their lot was happiness or misery, their own welfare, or their Lord.
rows.anchor: خلقهم من غير أن شاورهم ، وأثبتهم - على الوصف الذي أراده - دون أن خيرهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: By divine inspiration, even an infant is guided to take its mother's breast without prior instruction, warning, command, or rebuke.
rows.anchor: ثم بحكم الإلهام هداهم حتى قبل الصبي ثدي أمه وإن لم يكن قد تقدمه تعريف

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Hearing is given to hear God's address, sight to behold His acts, and hearts to know His right.
rows.anchor: جعل لكم السمع } : لتسمعوا خطابه ، { والأبصار } لتبصروا أفعاله ، { والأفئدة } لتعرفوا حقه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: These senses are gifts meant to lead people to gratitude for God's immense beneficence.
rows.anchor: ثم لتشكروا عظيم إنعامه عليكم بهذه الحواس

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A bird can remain aloft as though stationary without falling, an observable sign of divine sustaining power.
rows.anchor: الطائر إذا حلق في الهواء يبقى كالواقف ولا يسقط

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The bird's flight shows that God alone brings things into being and that no created event escapes His power, demonstrating its perfection.
rows.anchor: وقد قامت الدلالة على أن الحق - سبحانه - متفرد بالإيجاد ، ولا يخرج حادث عن قدرته

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: People have homelands of the soul and heart; the seeker travels inwardly as the heart changes and rises from one spiritual degree to another.
rows.anchor: المريد أو الطالب مسافر بقلبه لأنه يتلون ، ويرتقي من درجة إلى درجة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The knower is settled because he has arrived and become firmly established; spiritual stages are traversed by hearts, not souls.
rows.anchor: والعارف مقيم ومستوطن لأنه واصل متمكن . والطريق منازل ومراحل ، ولا تقطع تلك المنازل بالنفوس وإنما تقطع بالقلوب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: As God gives outward shade from trees and roofs, His care gives His friends a dwelling and resting place in its shade.
rows.anchor: في الظاهر جعل لكم من الأشجار والسقوف ونحوها ظلالا . . . كذلك جعل في ظل عنايته لأوليائه مثوى وقرارا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God clothes the innermost selves in a covering for prosperity and adversity, protects them from disobedience, and grants success that sustains worship and nearness.
rows.anchor: كذلك ألبس سرائركم لباسا يلفكم به في السراء والضراء ، ولباس العصمة يحميكم من مخالفته

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Completion of blessing means a good end, sufficiency in religious and worldly affairs, protection from desire, and guidance to what earns God's approval.
rows.anchor: إتمام النعمة بأنتكون عاقبتهم مختومة بالخير ، ويكفيهم أمور الدين والدنيا ، ويصونهم عن اتباع الهوى

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Once the message is delivered, the messenger is not responsible for deciding who receives guidance or goes astray.
rows.anchor: إذا بلغت الرسالة فما جعلنا إليك حكم الهداية والضلالة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: People seek divine success in obedience, yet after receiving it they may admire the obedience as their own achievement.
rows.anchor: يستوفقون إلى الطاعة ، فإذا فعلوا أعجبوا بها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The command to remove the sandals means renouncing both kinds of one's actions and erasing paired states—nearness and distance, union and separation, annihilation and subsistence—from one's witnessing.
rows.anchor: تبرأ عن نوعي أفعالك ، وامح عن الشهود جنسي أحوالك من قرب وبعد ، ووصل وفصل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Moses is to take on God's attribute and be through God, until he is stripped of self and overwhelmed by what he witnesses.
rows.anchor: وكن بوصفنا ؛ فإنما أنت بحقنا . أثبته في أحواله حتى كان كالمجرد عن جملته ، المصطلم عن شواهده

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The sacred valley is free of defects; the precincts of divine self-sufficiency transcend blemish and ornament, for God's sovereign flashes overpower everything.
rows.anchor: أي إنك بالوادي المقدس عن الأعلال ؛ وساحات الصمدية تجل عن كل شين ، وإيمان وزين

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God's choice, made with knowledge of Moses, strips and purifies him of illusions and whatever clouds his clarity.
rows.anchor: وعلى علم مني بك اصطفيتك ، وجردتك ونقيتك عن دنس الأوهام وكل ما يكدر صفوك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: After being chosen, Moses belongs to God and acts through Him, effaced from himself in annihilation.
rows.anchor: ويقال بعدما اخترتك فأنت لي وبي ، وأنت محو في فنائك عنك

words: إِنَّنِىٓ أَنَا ٱللَّهُ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّآ أَنَا۠
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God is transcendent from defect and likeness by His entitlement to majesty and beauty.
rows.anchor: تقدست عن الأعلال في أزلي ، وتنزهت ( . . . ) والأشكال باستحقاقي لجلالي وجمالي

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: In the Real's existence, all others are absent; forms and traces vanish when His reality is established.
rows.anchor: والرسوم والأطلال عند ثبوت حقي محو

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Worship means submitting to God's decree, carrying out His command, and yielding to the might of His dominion.
rows.anchor: أي تذلل لحكمي ، وأنفذ أمري ، واخضع لجبروت سلطاني

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Prayer performed without awareness of its true Originator produces self-admiration.
rows.anchor: إقامتها من غير ملاحظة مجريها ومنشيها يورث الإعجاب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: When a servant prays in witness and realizes another than himself establishes the prayer, it opens communion and the station of intimate nearness.
rows.anchor: وإذا أقام العبد صلاته على نعت الشهود والتحقق بأن مجريها غيره كانت الصلاة بهذا فتحا لباب المواصلة . والوقوف على محل النجوى

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The disclosure that the Hour is near is meant to wake people from separation; for those present in enduring remembrance, much promised for the afterlife is already realized now.
rows.anchor: الفائدة في تعريف العباد بقرب الساعة أن يستفيقوا من غفلات التفرقة ، فإذا حضروا بقلوبهم - ففي حال استدامة الذكر -

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The present can be like the afterlife for those who are present with God, and witnessing the current moment as resurrection marks spiritual uprightness.
rows.anchor: فما هو موعود في الآجل أكثره للحاضرين موجود في العاجل ؛ والحاضرة لهم كالآخرة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: One whom God awakens into direct witnessing should not descend from the heaven of spiritual qualities into the heedless hell of separation.
rows.anchor: فلا ينبغي أن ينزل عن سماء صفاته إلى جحيم أهل الغفلة في تطوحهم في أودية التفرقة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God repeated questions about the staff in several verses because He knew it would become the setting for a great miracle.
rows.anchor: كرر عليه السؤال في غير آية من عصاه لما كان المعلوم له سبحانه فيها من إظهاره فيها عظيم المعجزة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Another explanation is that Moses' sudden awe at hearing God's address was eased by returning him to the staff and its signs.
rows.anchor: ويقال إنما قال ذلك لأنه صحبته هيبة المقام عند فجأة سماع الخطاب ، فليسكن بعض ما به من بواده الإجلال

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: If Moses had remained under the force of awe, he might not have understood or been able to bear the encounter.
rows.anchor: لعله كان لا يعي ولا يطيق ذلك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The greatest sign is the inward witnessing and presence Moses finds in himself, including spiritual states known by direct taste rather than effort or personal control.
rows.anchor: الآية الكبرى هي ما كان يجده في نفسه من الشهود والوجود ، وما لا يكون بتكلف العبد وتصرفه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The verse says pocket rather than sleeve because Moses' clothing had no sleeves.
rows.anchor: وإنما قال : أدخل يدك في جيبك ولم يقل كمك لأنه لم يكن لما عليه من اللباس كمان

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: After honoring Moses with direct speech, God sent him to call Pharaoh despite knowing Pharaoh would not believe or respond; Moses accepted the ordeal over his own wish.
rows.anchor: فشق على موسى ذهابه إلى فرعون ، وسماع جحده منه ، بعد ما سمع من الله كلامه سبحانه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Moses sought the means and preparation needed to convey the message, illustrating that an obligation presupposes ability to perform it.
rows.anchor: ويقال لما أمره بالذهاب إلى فرعون سأل الله أهبة النقل وما به يتم تبليغ ما حمل من الرسالة ، ومن ذلك قوله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Another account says Moses kept asking because he could hardly stop speaking with God and continued his prayers through the remaining questions.
rows.anchor: ويقال إن موسى لما أخذ في المخاطبة مع الله كاد لا يسكت من كثرة ما سأله فظل يدعو

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Moses asks for an expanded breast and eased affair so he can bear hearing another's speech after hearing God's.
rows.anchor: حتى أطيق أن أسمع كلام غيرك بعدما سمعت منك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: He asks for an open tongue to address others and strength to answer through God rather than through himself.
rows.anchor: حتى ينطلق بمخاطبة غيرك ، وقوني حتى أرد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Moses asked Aaron to accompany him to Pharaoh to lessen the hardship of going among people, which brings estrangement.
rows.anchor: سأل أن يصحب أخاه معه ، ولما ذهب لسماع كلام الله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Another view says love requires solitude and exclusion of others: Aaron accompanied Moses to Pharaoh, but no one joined him at the private meeting with God.
rows.anchor: ويقال إن المحبة توجب التجرد والانفراد وألا يكون للغير مع المحب مساغ ؛ ففي ذهابه إلى فرعون

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Moses clarified that sharing his mission with Aaron served God's right, since together they could glorify and remember Him greatly, not their own interests.
rows.anchor: بين أن طلبه مشاركة أخيه له بحق ربه لا بحظ نفسه حيث قال : { كي نسبحك كثيرا ونذكرك كثيرا }

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God's granting Moses' request recalls earlier unsolicited favors: rescue from the river and grief, upbringing in an enemy's house, and love placed in Pharaoh's household despite the slaughter of infants; the giver of those favors fulfills his hope.
rows.anchor: والذي بدأك بهذه المنن هو الذي آتاك سولك ، وحقق لك مأمولك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The claim against Moses and Aaron was that they intended to expel the people from their land and disrupt their beliefs.
rows.anchor: هما في دعواهما كاذبان يقصدان إلى إخراجكم من بلدكم ، والتشويش عليكم في معتقدكم

words: إِمَّا أَن تُلْقِىَ وَإِمَّآ أَن نَّكُونَ أَوَّلَ مَنْ أَلْقَىٰ
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The magicians feigned confidence because they expected victory and trusted their own sorcery; they offered Moses first choice on that assumption.
rows.anchor: أظهروا من أنفسهم التجلد ظنا بأن النصرة لهم ، وإخلادا إلى ما كان السحرة يسولون لهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Moses' invitation to throw was not permission to practice sorcery; God intended to expose their deception.
rows.anchor: ليس ذلك إذنا لهم في السحر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The ropes only appeared to be snakes; Moses' staff swallowed the whole mass of ropes, then became a staff again, proving the magicians false.
rows.anchor: فلما خيلوا للناس بإلقاء الحبال أنها حيات ابتلعت عصا موسى جملة أوقار الحبال ، وصار الثعبان عصا كما كان

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Seeing the sign, the magicians prostrated in faith, while Pharaoh and his people were left defeated.
rows.anchor: فسجدوا لله مؤمنين ، وانقلب فرعون وقومه خائبين

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Pharaoh answered their conversion with threats of killing, crosswise amputation, crucifixion, and severe punishment.
rows.anchor: وتوعدهم بالقتل والصلب ، وفنون من العذاب الصعب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The magicians moved from swearing by Pharaoh's might to swearing by God, becoming believers and righteous within a single day.
rows.anchor: وبعدما كانوا يقسمون بعزة فرعون صاروا يحلفون بالله

words: لَن نُّؤْثِرَكَ عَلَىٰ مَا جَآءَنَا مِنَ ٱلْبَيِّنَٰتِ
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They swear by the One who created them that they will not prefer Pharaoh to the clear proofs and the Creator.
rows.anchor: أي بالله الذي فطرنا إنا لن نؤثرك على ما جاءنا من البينات

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The inward suns of gnosis and lights of divine care let them see God inwardly, confess faith, and prostrate in their hearts before what they witnessed.
rows.anchor: لما طلعت في أسرارهم شموس العرفان ، وانبسطت عليهم أنوار العناية أبصروا الحق سبحانه بأسرارهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Because they recognized the ordeal as coming from God, they found it sweet and endured hardship without shrinking from Pharaoh's threats.
rows.anchor: ورأوا ذلك من الله فاستعذبوا البلاء ، وتحملوا اللأواء

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The magicians knew that worldly suffering ends, however long it lasts.
rows.anchor: علموا أن البلاء في لدنيا ينقضي

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: For a person who knows God, the most important concern is that God forgive his errors.
rows.anchor: أهم الأشياء - على من عرفه - مغفرته لخطاياه

rows.speaker: النبي
rows.claim: The Prophet said that a veil sometimes comes over his heart and that he seeks God's forgiveness seventy times a day; Qushayri adduces this with scriptural examples of seeking forgiveness and divine pardon.
rows.anchor: إنه ليغان على قلبي فأستغفر الله في اليوم سبعين مرة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: An unattributed verse depicts disciplining the eye for admiring anyone other than the beloved; Qushayri links this to refusing a full gaze at worldly adornment.
rows.anchor: فعيني إذا استحسنت غيركم . . . أمرت الدموع بتأديبها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: In restraint from worldly beauty, the addressee stood on one foot until told to tread the earth with both feet, an image of extreme ascetic effort.
rows.anchor: وقف على وجه الأرض بفرد قدم تصاونا عنها حتى قيل له ( طه )

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Worldly adornment is a trial when it distracts from God, captures the heart, emboldens disobedience, or makes enjoyment lead to arrogance and excess.
rows.anchor: الفتنة ما يشغل به عن الحق ، ويستولي حبه على القلب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A little lawful provision accompanied by God's pleasure is better than much unlawful worldly wealth accompanied by His displeasure.
rows.anchor: القليل من الحلال - وفيه رضاء الرحمن - خير من الكثير

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Another gloss says a little that keeps one witnessing the Lord is better than much that makes one forget Him.
rows.anchor: ويقال قليل يشهدك ربك خير من كثير ينسيك ربك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Prayer opens the door of provision and is the means God directs people to when they need a breakthrough.
rows.anchor: الصلاة استفتاح باب الرزق ، وعليها أحال في تيسير الفتوح عند وقوع الحاجة إليه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Prayer is nourishment and healing for hearts; when the soul's nourishment is delayed, the heart's nourishment grows stronger.
rows.anchor: الصلاة رزق القلوب ، وفيها شفاؤها ، وإذا استأخر قوت النفس قوي قوت القلب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Istiṣbār has an added quality over patience: its practitioner feels no pain but is carried and comforted through it.
rows.anchor: وللاصطبار مزية على الصبر ؛ وهو ألا يجد صاحبه الألم بل يكون محمولا مروحا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God does not charge the Prophet with providing anyone; God alone provides for him and everyone, without creatures having causal power over provision.
rows.anchor: لا نكلفك برزق أحد ، فإن الرازق الله - سبحانه - دون تأثير الخلق ، فنحن نرزقك ونرزق الجميع

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: There are two matters: having provisions strengthens souls, while witnessing the Provider strengthens hearts.
rows.anchor: هما شيئان : وجود الأرزاق وشهود الرزاق ؛ فوجود الأرزاق يوجب قوة النفوس ، وشهود الرزاق يوجب قوة القلوب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Ordinary people are sustained by the existence of provisions, whereas the elect are sustained by witnessing the Provider.
rows.anchor: ويقال استقلال العامة بوجود الأرزاق ، واستقلال الخواص بشهود الرزاق

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Whoever realizes the divine 'We' no longer distinguishes one provision from another.
rows.anchor: فإن من شهد وتحقق بقوله : { نحن } سقط عنه التمييز بين رزق ورزق

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The promise 'We provide' consoles the poor when provision is scarce or delayed.
rows.anchor: خففف على الفقراء مقاساة قلة الرزق وتأخره عن وقت إلى وقت بقوله : { نحن }

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The good end belongs to the people of piety; the word for piety may also designate the pious person by naming the one described with the verbal noun.
rows.anchor: العاقبة بالحسنى لأهل التقوى . ويقال المراد بالتقوى المتقي ، فقد يسمى الموصوف بما هو المصدر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Those who demanded proof were blind in insight; the failure lay in their perception, not in the evidence.
rows.anchor: عميت بصائرهم وادعوا أنه لا برهان معه ، ولم يكن القصور في الأدلة بل كان الخلل في بصائرهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Even every sign they requested would only increase their tyranny, disbelief, and loss if God did not will them to believe.
rows.anchor: ولو جمع الله لهم كل آية اقترحت على رسول ثم لم يرد } الله أن يؤمنوا لما ازدادوا إلا طغيانا وكفرا وخسرانا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Had they been destroyed before a messenger came, they would have protested that no messenger had been sent; yet when messengers come, they answer with endless excuses.
rows.anchor: إن أرسلنا إليهم الرسل قابلوهم بفنون من الجحد ، ووجوه من العلل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They object that a messenger is human, but would object to an angel as unlike themselves; they call a miracle fabricated magic and demand a messenger if left without one.
rows.anchor: مرة يقولون فما بال هذا الرسول بشر ؟ هلا أرسله ملكا ؟

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A verse about the bored person who tires of union illustrates how those unwilling to love always find a pretext to break away.
rows.anchor: وكذلك سبيل من لا يجنح إلى الوصال ولا يرغب في الوداد ، وفي معناه أنشدوا : وكذا إذا الملول قطيعة . . . مل الوصال

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: All await what may come without certainty: people of separation look to the spheres, natures, and stars, while Muslims await God's decrees in the spirit of divine unity; others remain in associational darkness.
rows.anchor: المسلمون ينتظرون ما يبدو من المقادير فهم في روح التوحيد ، والباقون في ظلمات الشرك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God's mighty name grants beautiful favor to obedience and respite to neglect; return and confession bring remembrance, sin is concealed, repentance is met with mercy, and arrogance is crushed.
rows.anchor: إن أطاع فضله ، وإن أضاع أمهله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Outward illumination comes from God's enabling, while inner illumination comes from His realization; enabling gives worshippers spiritual striving, and realization gives knowers complete witnessing.
rows.anchor: ما استنارت الظواهر إلا بآثار توفيقه ، وما استضاءت السرائر إلا بأنوار تحقيقه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Complete spiritual striving earns future recompense, while abiding in witnessing wins immediate nearness.
rows.anchor: وبتمام مجاهدتهم وجدوا آجل مثوبتهم ، وبدوام مشاهدتهم نالوا عاجل قربتهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Among people, the obedient merit a great reward from God, and the disobedient deserve His punishment.
rows.anchor: فالمطيعون منهم عظم لدينا ثوابهم ، والعاصون منهم حق منا عقابهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: One heedlessness is absorption in worldly life and desire, a mark of alienation whose sufferers awaken only at death.
rows.anchor: غافل عن حسابه باستغراقه في دنياه وهواه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A second heedlessness is absorption in the Lord, a quality of union; these people never return from ecstatic absence because they are effaced in divine existence.
rows.anchor: غافل عن حسابه لاستهلاكه في مولاه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The rejecters grow more averse to messengers and reject every new address; each clarification is called a joke and each new favor becomes a trial that brings punishment.
rows.anchor: لم يجدد إليهم رسولا إذا ازدادوا نفورا ، ولم ينزل عليهم خطابا إلا ردوه جحدا وتكذيبا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: This conduct shows people behaving badly toward God and forfeiting their due; their blindness is in their insight and understanding, not an absence of proof.
rows.anchor: وهذه صفة من أساء مع الله خلقه ، وخسر عند الله حقه . عميت بصائرهم وعامت أفهامهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Unable to answer the Prophet's challenge or overcome his proof, they speculated privately and accused him of magic, poetry, madness, and other defects.
rows.anchor: لما عجزوا عن معارضته ، وسقطوا عن التحدي ، وظهرت عليهم حجته رجموا فيه الفكر ، وقسموا فيه الظن

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Their accusations reversed their former view of Muhammad as trustworthy; a cited poem illustrates former allies becoming enemies and spreading a vile tale.
rows.anchor: كانوا يقولون عنه : هو محمد الأمين ، كما قيل : أشاعوا لنا في الحي أشنع قصة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Speech heard by God takes different forms: some people speak to one another, while others address God in supplication or praise.
rows.anchor: الأقاويل التي يسمعها الحق - سبحانه - مختلفة ؛ فمن خطاب بعضهم مع بعض

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Among those who address God are people asking for worldly goods, supplicants seeking the best of the afterlife, and praisers who seek neither.
rows.anchor: فمن سائل يسأل الدنيا ، ومن داع يطلب كرائم العقبى ، ومن مثن يثني على الله لا يقصد شيئا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God hears sinners' secret groans, hidden from others for fear of disgrace, as well as worshippers' glorification during night vigil.
rows.anchor: يسمع أنين المذنبين سرا عن الخلق حذرا أن يفتضحوا ، ويسمع مناجاة العابدين التسبيح إذا تهجدوا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God hears lovers complain when the pain of longing overwhelms them, and hears private intimate speech and praise voiced by the secret heart.
rows.anchor: شكوى المحبين إذا مستهم البرحاء فضجوا من شدة الاشتياق

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The changing allegations reflect their own projections: they did not witness the Prophet's striving as truthful in state and speech.
rows.anchor: نوعوا ما نسبوا إليه - بعدما نزلنا إليه الأمر - من حيث كانوا ، ولم يشاهدوا هممه على الوصف الذي كانوا يصفونه به

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God's established way is to punish those whose known final state is unbelief; the disbelievers of the Prophet's era were ruled deprived and forsaken.
rows.anchor: أجرى سنته أن يعذب من كان المعلوم من شأنه أنه لا يؤمن لا في الحال ولا في المآل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The command addresses everyone but intends the Muslim community; one view identifies the people of remembrance as leading scholars who believe in Muhammad.
rows.anchor: الخطاب للكل والمراد منه الأمة ، وأهل الذكر العلماء من أكابر هذه الأمة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Another view identifies them as people who understand God through inspiration and stand where divine disclosure informs them.
rows.anchor: ويقال هم أهل الفهم من الله أصحاب الإلهام الذين في محل الإعلام من الحق - سبحانه -

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A further gloss means anyone skilled at explaining what comes from God.
rows.anchor: أو من يحسن الإفهام عن الحق

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A qualified scholar refers to God in worship and practical matters and may give independent legal judgment in an ambiguous case; accept it when it conflicts with neither text nor a sound foundational proof.
rows.anchor: العالم يرجع إلى الله في المعاملات والعبادات ، وإذا اشتكلت الواقعة فيخبر عن اجتهاده

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A spiritual teacher's guidance about conduct is accepted only after he has personally undergone the spiritual station in question; otherwise his advice is like a legal imitator's.
rows.anchor: وأما الحكيم فإذا تكلم في المعاملة فإنما يقبل منه إذا سبقت منه المنازلة لما يفتي به

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A gnostic should speak on this path only from his own realized experience; without it, his spiritual judgment is neither accepted nor heard.
rows.anchor: وإلا فلا تقبل فتواه ولا تشمع

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A messenger's eating does not diminish the distinguishing spiritual qualities of the elite; bodily nourishment does not contradict what hearts and innermost selves receive of divine knowledge.
rows.anchor: أكل الطعام ليس بقادح في المعنى الذي يختص به الأكابر ، فلا منافاة بين أكل الطعام وما تكنه القلوب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The soul does not know what the heart experiences, and the heart does not know what the spirit and the subtler secret realize.
rows.anchor: النفوس لا خبر لها مما به القلوب ، والقلب لا خبر له مما تتحقق به الروح

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: People are only passing through; no creature in this world has immortality.
rows.anchor: إنهم على ممر ومعبر ، ولا سبيل اليوم لمخلوق إلى الخلد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God fulfills what He promises even if its appointed time is delayed; support for people of truth means raising religion through proof and exposing opponents' errors.
rows.anchor: الحق - سبحانه - يحقق وعده وإن تباطأ بتحقيقه الوقت

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The book is the Qur'an, and the remembrance it contains means the community's honor and standing; whoever sees by its light prospers in this life and the next.
rows.anchor: يريد بالكتاب القرآن ، وقوله : { فيه ذكركم } : أي شرفكم ومحلكم ، فمن استبصر بما فيه من النور

words: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ إِن كُنتُمْ فِى رَيْبٍۢ مِّنَ ٱلْبَعْثِ
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Those who doubt resurrection dismiss it without considering the evidence; God answers their doubt with proof that cuts off their argument, and following guidance brings success.
rows.anchor: فلم ينكر الحق عليهم إلا بإعراضهم عن تأمل البرهان ، واحتج عليهم في ذلك بما قطع حجتهم ، فمن تبع هداه رشد

words: فَإِنَّا خَلَقْنَٰكُم مِّن تُرَابٍۢ ثُمَّ مِن نُّطْفَةٍۢ
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God argues for resurrection from the stages of human creation and the transitions from infancy through youth, old age, and death: the One who first creates and changes people can raise them again.
rows.anchor: وأنه ينقلهم من حال إلى حال أخرى ؛ فبدأهم من نطفة إلى علقة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Spring's revival of the dead winter earth shows that the One who restores it can bring life to decayed bodies and worn bones.
rows.anchor: يحيي الأرض - في حال الربيع - بعد موتها ، فتعود إلى ما كانت عليه في الربيع

words: وَمِنكُم مَّن يُرَدُّ إِلَىٰٓ أَرْذَلِ ٱلْعُمُرِ
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: One inward gloss calls the lowest age a period of spiritual stagnation after striving.
rows.anchor: زمان الفترة بعد المجاهدة

words: وَمِنكُم مَّن يُرَدُّ إِلَىٰٓ أَرْذَلِ ٱلْعُمُرِ
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Another gloss identifies it as being veiled after having witnessed God.
rows.anchor: حال الحجبة عقب المشاهدة

words: وَمِنكُم مَّن يُرَدُّ إِلَىٰٓ أَرْذَلِ ٱلْعُمُرِ
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Another interpretation is returning to the pursuit of personal desires after fulfilling one's duties.
rows.anchor: السعي للحظوظ بعد القيام بالحقوق

words: وَمِنكُم مَّن يُرَدُّ إِلَىٰٓ أَرْذَلِ ٱلْعُمُرِ
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A further gloss calls it a lapse in old age.
rows.anchor: الزلة في زمان المشيب

words: وَمِنكُم مَّن يُرَدُّ إِلَىٰٓ أَرْذَلِ ٱلْعُمُرِ
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Another interpretation is remaining in the abodes of disobedience.
rows.anchor: الإقامة في منازل العصيان

words: وَمِنكُم مَّن يُرَدُّ إِلَىٰٓ أَرْذَلِ ٱلْعُمُرِ
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Another gloss describes lingering in places of abasement.
rows.anchor: التعريج في أوطان المذلة

words: وَمِنكُم مَّن يُرَدُّ إِلَىٰٓ أَرْذَلِ ٱلْعُمُرِ
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Another view sees the lowest age as keeping company with adversaries.
rows.anchor: العشرة مع الأضداد

words: وَمِنكُم مَّن يُرَدُّ إِلَىٰٓ أَرْذَلِ ٱلْعُمُرِ
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Another gloss means living without recognizing one's own worth.
rows.anchor: عيش المرء بحيث لا يعرف قدره

words: وَمِنكُم مَّن يُرَدُّ إِلَىٰٓ أَرْذَلِ ٱلْعُمُرِ
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Another interpretation is being left to rely on oneself.
rows.anchor: بأن يوكل إلى نفسه

words: وَمِنكُم مَّن يُرَدُّ إِلَىٰٓ أَرْذَلِ ٱلْعُمُرِ
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Another gloss is wandering in the illusion that anything exists independently of God.
rows.anchor: التطوح في أودية الحسبان أن شيئا بغير الله

words: وَمِنكُم مَّن يُرَدُّ إِلَىٰٓ أَرْذَلِ ٱلْعُمُرِ
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A final gloss describes relying on self-management while blind to God's decree.
rows.anchor: الإخلاد إلى تدبير النفس ، والعمى عن شهود تقدير الحق

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God is the Real and absolute existence; He is the Real, meaning the possessor of truth.
rows.anchor: الله هو الحق ، والحق المطلق الوجود ، وهو الحق أي ذو الحق

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Outwardly, God revives the earth after winter's desolation in spring.
rows.anchor: الأرض التي أصابتها وحشة الشتاء يحييها وقت الربيع

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God revives souls by enabling acts of worship and hearts through the lights of direct witnessing.
rows.anchor: ويقال يحيي النفوس بتوفيق العبادات ، ويحيي القلوب بأنوار المشاهدات

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God brings seekers' spiritual states to life through His gracious attention.
rows.anchor: ويقال يحيي أحوال المريدين بحسن إقباله عليهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A time comes alive through compliance with God's command, followed by contentment and composure as His decree unfolds.
rows.anchor: حياة الأوقات بموافقة الأمر ، ثم بجميل الرضا وسكون الجأش عند جريان التقدير

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The verse's implication permits disputation about God when the disputant knows the evidence and can defend the religion with proof.
rows.anchor: دليل الخطاب يقتضي جواز المجادلة في الله إذا كان صاحب المجادلة على علم بالدليل والحجة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Gnostics prostrate to God in worship, while rejecters prostrate through every part of themselves as testimony to His existence.
rows.anchor: أهل العرفان يسجدون له سجود عبادة ، وأرباب الجحود كل جزء منهم يسجد له سجود دلالة وشهادة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A cited verse asks whether everything bears a sign pointing to God's oneness.
rows.anchor: وفي كل شيء له آية . . . تدل على أنه واحد ؟

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: For rejecters, today's clothing is shirk and deprivation, with falsehood and abandonment as its trim; in the afterlife it is pitch and estrangement.
rows.anchor: أما الذين كفروا فلهم اليوم لباس الشرك وطرازه الحرمان ، ثم صدار الإفك وطرازه الخذلان

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Believers' present garment of piety has degrees: avoiding association, disobedience, heedlessness, reliance on other than God, and delight in what is other than Him.
rows.anchor: أما أصحاب الإيمان فلباسهم اليوم التقوى ، وتنقسم إلى اجتناب الشرك ثم مجانبة المخالفة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: In the next life, some believers wear silk, others the cloak of love, solitude with God, or spiritual detachment.
rows.anchor: وفي الآخرة لباسهم فيها حرير ، وآخرون لباسهم صدار المحبة ، وآخرون لباسهم الانفراد به

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The elect are strangers and the highest class, with no state, station, rank, or place and no servitude to anything brought into being.
rows.anchor: فلا حال ولا مقام ولا منزلة ولا محل وهم الغرباء ، وهم الطبقة العليا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Their spiritual adornment protects them and conceals their states; they beautify Paradise rather than needing Paradise to adorn them.
rows.anchor: التحلية تحصين لهم ، وستر لأحوالهم ؛ فهم للجنة زينة ، وليس لهم بالجنة زينة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A cited couplet says that just as a pearl beautifies a face, the beloved's beauty makes the pearl itself beautiful, illustrating their being Paradise's adornment.
rows.anchor: وإذا الدر زان حسن وجوه . . . كان للدر حسن وجهك زينا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: One gloss calls pure speech what issues from a sincere heart and clear inner self, agreeable to sound monotheism and unobjectionable to its principles.
rows.anchor: الطيب من القول ما صدر عن قلب خالص ، وسر صاف مما يرضى به علم التوحيد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Another view takes pure speech to be exhortation for people seeking guidance.
rows.anchor: ويقال الطيب من القول ما يكون وعظا للمسترشدين

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Another gloss is guiding aspirants toward God.
rows.anchor: ويقال الطيب من القول هو إرشاد المريدين إلى الله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Another interpretation is enjoining what is right and forbidding what is wrong.
rows.anchor: ويقال الأمر بالمعروف والنهي عن المنكر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Another view identifies pure speech as praying for Muslims.
rows.anchor: ويقال الدعاء للمسلمين

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Another gloss is speaking a word of truth before someone who is feared or hoped in.
rows.anchor: ويقال كلمة حق عند من يخاف ويرجى

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Another view means the two testimonies spoken from a sincere heart.
rows.anchor: ويقال الشهادتان عن قلب مخلص

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: One gloss describes speech whose speaker is forgiven and caused to speak.
rows.anchor: ويقال ما كان قائله فيه مغفورا وهو مستنطق

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Another interpretation is the declaration of seeking forgiveness by a servant free of sins.
rows.anchor: ويقال هو بيان الاستغفار والعبد برئ من الذنوب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Another gloss is confessing, 'Our Lord, we have wronged ourselves.'
rows.anchor: ويقال الإقرار بقوله : { ربنا ظلمنا أنفسنا } { الأعراف : 23 ]

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A further view is praying for Muslims without seeking any personal share in that prayer.
rows.anchor: ويقال أن تدعو للمسلمين بما لا يكون لك فيه نصيب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The genitive construction is attributive, comparable to saying 'the جامع mosque'; the praised path is the approved path.
rows.anchor: وأما { صراط الحميد } : فالإضافة فيه كالإضافة عند قولهم : مسجد الجامع أي المسجد الجامع

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The approved path is what the revealed law attests as sound, with which spiritual reality has no fault to find.
rows.anchor: والصراط الحميد : الطريق المرضي وهو ما شهدت له الشريعة بالصحة ، وليس للحقيقة عليه نكير
